name: Clockodile
tagline: Track time, bill clients, export clean PDF timesheets.
description: A calm, fast time tracker that lives in your menu bar. Start a timer or log time in one line ("Design review 1h30 @acme #meeting"), see your week at a glance, mark entries as billed or paid, and export polished PDF timesheets or CSV. Idle detection, rates per client and project, rounding, and all data stays on your computer.
